The SEC Should Block Anthropic's IPO to Protect the Public
top.detail: If Anthropic goes public, workers, retail investors, and retirees will be left holding the bag when its bills come due, writes Matt Scherer. / The SEC Should Block Anthropic’s IPO to Protect the Public | TechPolicy.Press Perspective The SEC Should Block Anthropic’s IPO to Protect the Public Matt Scherer / Nov 2, 2026 Matt Scherer is co-author of the recent report Brace for Impact: Protecting people and the economy when the AI bubble bursts . Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei looks on as United States President Donald Trump holds a press briefing with AI executives following a meeting on artificial intelligence, outside the West Wing of the White House on September 29, 2026 in Washington, DC. (Photo by Kevin Dietsch/Getty Images) Republish Share Things are seldom what they seem when it comes to the finances of the AI industry. The AI ecosystem’s circular business dealings , extensive use of financial engineering , and otherwise murky finances make it hard for investors, regulators, or workers saving for retirement to get an accurate financial picture of AI companies. That is particularly true of Anthropic, which filed the registration statement for its initial public offering (IPO) last week ahead of a planned November stock market debut. The company’s topline financial figures look quite impressive for a startup, with revenues that appear to have grown quickly over the course of 2026 and a fairly healthy balance sheet — on the surface, that is.
